content: SoftBodies_Soft_Body_Deformation: Jelly cubes and soft mills  --  basic deformation
SoftBodies_Carusell: Carousel of soft cloth and mushrooms  --  playful physics
SoftBodies_Obsticals: Breathing rooms and flag dancers  --  soft bodies meet obstacles
SoftBodies_Cloth_Physics: Cloth simulation  --  draping, tearing, wind

softbodies.description: From cloth draping to Turing patterns  --  matter that deforms, bounces, and self-organizes. Starts with soft body physics (jelly, cloth, obstacles), then expands into morphogenesis: how biological form emerges from reaction-diffusion dynamics. Alan Turing's last paper becomes a VR experience.
learning_objectives: Spring-mass systems as soft body foundation
Cloth physics  --  constraints on deformable surfaces
Affect and materiality  --  what softness means
Turing's reaction-diffusion  --  pattern from chemical dynamics

softbodies.name: Soft Bodies & Morphogenesis: Matter That Finds Its Shape
softbodies.qfep_connection: Soft bodies embody F=E oscillation physically  --  elastic forces (F) against deformation (E). Morphogenesis extends this: Turing's reaction-diffusion shows how pattern emerges from the tension between activation and inhibition, the chemical F and E.
softbodies.truth: Form is not imposed  --  it emerges from the material's own dynamics.

artifact_groups.rationale: Spring-mass foundation: jelly cube jiggles under contact, softmill grinds rotation against compliance. Matter negotiating between rigid and liquid.
Playful carousel: centripetal force spins soft mushrooms, cloth straps drape and collide, revolving joy ride teaches deformation through contact rather than instruction.
Walls that breathe, flags that dance. Soft bodies negotiate obstacles  --  structures must continuously earn form against pressure, gravity, and wind.
Extended obstacle gallery: yielding matter wraps and compresses around unyielding structure. Twelve test scenarios deepen non-collisional deformation understanding.
Dedicated cloth chamber: draping, tearing, wind. Springs connecting vertices solve collective equilibrium  --  cloth thinks with its whole body.
Free play: growth algorithms seed organic structures, grid agents multiply, rounded soft bodies scatter. Elasticity as medium, deformation as play.
Single radiolarian specimen: silica skeleton emergent from surface tension, not designed but negotiated. Bridges physical simulation to affect theory  --  softness as capacity to be affected.
Turing's reaction-diffusion: activator and inhibitor diffusing at different speeds produce spots, stripes, labyrinths. Pattern from process, no blueprint.
Entropy becoming morphology: the boundary where disorder finds structure. Topological contraction as morphogenetic principle  --  form emerges from negotiation, not imposition.
New catalyst affordance demo for the softbodies phase: flex_cloth_pad.
Introduces soft body physics with basic deformation. Jelly cube and soft mill as tactile first contact.
Playful carousel of soft physics objects. Foundation map building on deformation with variety.
Soft bodies meeting obstacles. Breathing room and flag dancer show environmental interactions.
Extended obstacle gallery. Deeper engagement with soft body obstacle interactions.
Dedicated cloth simulation. Draping, tearing, and wind as focused exploration.
Free play combining soft bodies with growth algorithms. Mid-sequence creative space.
Softness as theoretical concept. Radiolaria bridges physical simulation to affect theory.
Absorbed morphogenesis map. Turing patterns connect soft body dynamics to reaction-diffusion chemistry.
Absorbed morphogenesis synthesis. Entropy becoming form, the boundary where disorder finds structure.
